verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Netlify offers serverless functions ('Build APIs with serverless functions', community mentions of 'zero-config Lambda functions'). Nothing in the pack documents that these functions run unmodified Node.js code or arbitrary npm packages rather than a restricted runtime subset. The one runtime-related comment lists only JS/TS/Go language support and says nothing about Node API or npm compatibility, so the story's specific capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
